title: CommunityPasteCreatedPayload
description: community.paste.created v1 (OpenVibe.Community server/events.js, queued in the transaction of the change). A paste (text or screenshot) was created. Never the content or title. Envelope: subject { type: paste, id }, visibility public when the item is public else internal, priority low, actor the person or service:community.

origin.description: ai: written by OpenVibe's AI (Moments); never shown as a person's work.

url.description: The public page, or null when the item is not public.
